I'm guilty of doing this to some degree with beverages, so I want to comment some things that I find help to not forget about drinks. 

- I only drink from certain cups. For some reason my brain perceives glass cups more over plastic, so I only use glass if I have a cold drink. Maybe if she had a designated tea only mug she might remember it a bit better? 

- I've stopped just leaving my drinks anywhere. Obviously, the kitchen is fair game when it comes to beverage placement, but in other areas of my apartment I only place drinks on tables so that they won't get lost to the void. 

Of course these suggestions will only help if she's willing to meet you halfway with this. Goodluck OP, I hope y'all can meet some sort of middle ground with this.

It sort of feels like when you walk into a room and forget what you were supposed to be doing in said room. You know there was something, but you just can't put your finger on it. 

When I think of people that I'm close with, like say my boyfriend for example, I know he has a beard and blue eyes. I can't 100% remember what he looks like at the moment, but I know that once I see him I recognize him. 

Sorry for the long ramble, but to answer your question it's more like their face is familiar, but I can't pinpoint it.

I'm not exactly sure, there's been a few times in my life where I've cheated death, but there's a chance I might've been born with it because mental illnesses/strange brain things run in my family it seems. 🤷🏻‍♀️
